typography.rules: Use tight letter spacing for headings (tracking-tight), uppercase small tracking for overlines. H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl max, H2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl, Body: text-base.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust Smart Classroom Management System with JWT authentication (Admin/Teacher and Student demo roles), Dashboard metrics, Student Management (CRUD + search), Attendance Management (date-wise Present/Absent & percentage), Timetable, Announcements, Assignment Management, Student Self-Dashboard, Notifications, and Reports. Use Tailwind CSS with clean academic teal/blue styling, Shadcn UI primitives (.js format), and Sonner for toasts. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use universal transition (e.g. transition: all).
Never center app container text (.App { text-align: center; }).
Ensure glassmorphism has solid fallback and no fully transparent headers/dropdowns.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
